**If Rustgram updated itself to v0.2.0-alpha.4 and no longer starts** (Windows says
"avutil-61.dll was not found"): v0.2.0-alpha.4 was available for about 15 minutes, and its update
left out the media libraries the new version needs. To repair the copy, unzip
`rustgram-0.2.0-alpha.5-win-x64-portable.zip` over the folder that holds `rustgram.exe` and replace
all files, or, for a copy installed with the installer, run `Rustgram-Setup-0.2.0-alpha.5-win-x64.exe`.
Then start Rustgram. Your accounts, chats and settings are not affected.

**If the menu says "New version is ready · v0.2.0-alpha.4":** do not restart to install it. Quit
Rustgram, delete the `tupdates` folder in Rustgram's data folder (`%APPDATA%\Rustgram` by default)
and start Rustgram again; it then downloads this release. Other copies update to this release by
themselves.

Fixes for the bugs reported on v0.2.0-alpha.2 (tray, own profile photo in groups, the "@" and unread
counters, "typing", stickers), media that sends in the background, connections that recover by
themselves, and an FFmpeg with the latest memory-safety fixes.

**Updating from v0.2.0-alpha.2:** if you installed v0.2.0-alpha.2 by hand over a copy that had
already downloaded v0.2.0-alpha.1, the menu may say "New version is ready · v0.2.0-alpha.1". That is
an older version: do not restart to install it. Quit Rustgram, delete the `tupdates` folder in
Rustgram's data folder (`%APPDATA%\Rustgram` by default) and start Rustgram again; it then downloads
this release as usual.

## Highlights

- **Closing the window keeps Rustgram in the tray.** The tray shows the app icon, a click brings the
  window back, and the tray menu matches Telegram Desktop.
- **Counters you can trust.** Unread badges count like Telegram Desktop (folder tabs count chats, not
  messages), the "@" counter drops when you see the mention, and the scroll-to-bottom button shows
  how many messages are new.
- **"Typing…" goes away.** The status expires after a few seconds, on cancel and when the message
  arrives.
- **Your own profile photo in groups** next to your messages in a wide window, like Telegram Desktop.
- **Stickers.** Static stickers are drawn instead of a blue circle, and a click opens the sticker set.
- **Media sends in the background.** A photo, video, file or voice message appears in the chat at
  once and uploads without freezing the window; files sent in a row keep their order.
- **Connections recover.** After a network change or sleep Rustgram reconnects in seconds instead of
  waiting for minutes.
- **Safer media decoding.** The bundled FFmpeg contains the memory-safety fixes Telegram Desktop
  shipped in 7.4.6 (MP4 reader, AAC decoder, AV1 decoder).

Plus about 40 more fixes and improvements.

<details>
<summary>All changes</summary>

### New

- Round video messages play while they download; voice messages too.
- Stories load in the background, and a video story starts after its first part.
- Messages made only of custom emoji are drawn large.
- A held selection drag scrolls the chat; selection works inside quotes and code blocks.
- Chats with "Restrict saving content" block copying, like Telegram Desktop.
- Ctrl+C in the media viewer copies the photo.
- The saved interface scale is applied at start; changing it offers a restart.
- The theme editor changes the app's theme at once; theme files ask "Keep this theme?".
- Switching the language reaches the server without a restart.
- Checklist ticks and new tasks from other members update the message you already see.

### Fixed

- Closing the main window hides it to the tray instead of quitting; the tray icon is the app icon.
- The stories tooltip closes on its ×.
- Unread badges: folder tabs count unread chats, loaded history is not counted twice, reading part of
  a chat lowers the counter, archived chats count as muted on the tray badge.
- The "@" button appears for a mention that arrives after "mark all as read".
- Spoilers stay hidden in reply headers, chat-list rows, search results and the pinned bar.
- A pending or failed media message keeps its photo, file or voice recording instead of going empty.
- A request to a media server can no longer hang after its authorization was moved there.
- A connection that goes silent, also while the encryption key is created, is restarted.
- An update downloaded by an older copy is no longer offered after you install a newer version by
  hand: Rustgram deletes it at start, and the updater refuses to install anything older than the
  version you run.
- An update now brings every file the new version needs, including the media libraries, and the
  library files an older version left behind are removed.
- Recording without a microphone is refused instead of sending a tone.
- The mouse wheel scrolls the same distance as in Telegram Desktop.
- Profile "Mute" shows no extra toast; "Unmute" is green in the profile menu.
- Sticker time, fact-check cards and selected large emoji are laid out like Telegram Desktop.
- Chat export: the bot-allowed text, a JSON key name and formatting ranges past the end of a text.
- A folder edited during the session shows its new chats; the chat list retries a failed page.

### Faster

- Sending media, saving settings and loading chat-list pages no longer wait on the window.
- The chat list, search results and the emoji panel do less work on every frame.
- A sent file is not downloaded again; round videos download only when they play.

### Known issues

- Albums and scheduled media still upload while the window waits.
- Text is drawn slightly differently from Telegram Desktop 7.4.7, which changed its text rendering.

</details>

## Install or update

- **Installer:** `Rustgram-Setup-0.2.0-alpha.5-win-x64.exe`.
- **Portable:** unzip `rustgram-0.2.0-alpha.5-win-x64-portable.zip` and run `rustgram.exe`.
- Installed copies update themselves (pre-releases: beta channel only).
- Check a download: `gh attestation verify <file> -R murmaider227/rustgram`, or compare it with
  `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
